name: Milepost
description: A product team’s public roadmap told as a timeline: lanes in the team’s own priority order, a dated rail down the page, quiet cards with no vote counts in front, and an item page that leads with the team’s answer.
modelledOn: A developer tool’s public timeline roadmap
features: Preset: timeline — Now / Next / Later down one dated rail, each lane in the team’s manual priority order
Board opens on the team’s order (`filters.defaultSort: manual`), with Top and New one click away
Pinned items carry a pin mark; the vote control is a quiet pill at the end of the card
Item page: the team’s answer first, then the conversation; facts and Follow on the right
Warm paper and ink, Source Serif headings, the site’s reading column
Zero custom CSS — every detail is a theme setting

sections.problem: Our field team loses signal on site visits and cannot open the app at all.
sections.proposal: Keep recent projects on the device, queue edits while offline and sync them when the connection returns, flagging any conflict.

response.author: team
response.markdown: In progress: reading offline works in the beta; queued edits are next.

sections.problem: A missed webhook during an outage on our side means a silently missing record.
sections.proposal: Sign every delivery, retry with backoff for a day, and show a delivery log per endpoint.

response.author: team
response.markdown: Being built now; the delivery log ships first.

sections.problem: Everyone rebuilds the same filters every morning.
sections.proposal: Save a filter and sort as a named view, share it with the team, and pin it to the sidebar.

sections.problem: We cannot tell which teams actually use the seats we pay for.
sections.proposal: A monthly report of active members per team, exportable, with a trend line.

response.author: team
response.markdown: Next; the export follows the same format as every other report.

sections.problem: Every client tracks one or two things we have no field for.
sections.proposal: Add text, number, date and choice fields per workspace, usable in filters and views.

sections.problem: Due dates live here and meetings live in the calendar; nothing connects them.
sections.proposal: Sync due dates to Google and Outlook calendars both ways.

sections.problem: Two of our colleagues navigate entirely by keyboard and kept getting stuck in dialogs.
sections.proposal: Every control reachable and labelled; focus never trapped; tested with screen readers.

response.author: team
response.markdown: Shipped in 4.2 after an external audit.
